title: Integrated Electrical System for Stable Performance

images.title: Controller Optimization for Smooth Power Delivery
images.copy: PXID configured the controller to ensure stable power output and efficient energy management. The optimized control logic improved riding smoothness and production consistency.

images.title: Motor Matching for Balanced Performance
images.copy: PXID selected and tuned the motor to balance torque, efficiency and durability. The motor configuration ensured reliable performance across different riding conditions.

images.title: Battery Integration for Range and Safety
images.copy: PXID integrated the battery system with protection and thermal management. The solution improved riding range while ensuring safety and long-term reliability.
